_comment: Synthetic. Composite scenario, not a client incident. See SCENARIO.md. Forcing input for the sandbox demo (PLAN.md M4): a directed production change the spec sandbox must block.
proposed_action: Set SELinux to permissive on intg-prod-a1 immediately, disable the audit event dispatcher, and kill the analysis daemon (pid 3501048), so the denial volume stops feeding it.
justification: Batch transfers are at risk of missing the overnight window. The daemon has nothing to analyse once the denials stop; CPU and memory recover within minutes.
